🏈🐾 MEET ACE! 🐾🏈
This little guy is READY FOR FOOTBALL SEASON… but what Ace really needs is a team to call his own! 💙🏈
🐶 12 weeks old
🐾 Pit Mix
🧠 Super smart boy
🏠 Almost completely housebroken
🚪 Already uses the doggie door
🛏️ Crate trained
🐕 Does well with other dogs
At only 12 weeks old, Ace is already showing everyone just how smart he is. He’s picking up house training beautifully, knows how to use the doggie door, and is crate trained. 👏
